# möbius for macOS 0.3.8

- The message rail is redrawn: one short tick per message at rest, turns told apart by shade. Under the pointer the ticks swell like the Dock, and a card shows your message with the opening of its reply.
- Long chats pack the rail's ticks closer instead of scrolling, so the preview card is never clipped.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.16.3 (protocol 88).
